title: Long War Index glossary export (glossary/core.json)
description: A glossary term is a term that the rules use and that no rule gives to a unit. The term page on the site is the source of the name, the page and the text.

data_version.description: Hash of the file content. It changes only when the content changes.

id.description: Permanent: never changed or reused. The path of the term page, for example shooting_phase/snap_shots.

text.description: The text as plain text, in the form of the special rules export: no Markdown, no HTML and no wiki links. One blank line separates two paragraphs. Each list item is on its own line and starts with "- ". Each row of a table is one line, with a tab character between two cells.

other_spellings.description: Other spellings that the books print, for example "Peril of the Warp".
